notes.title: ESCAPEWORLD DILEMMA NOW FREE TO PLAY
notes.content:
It has been over 2 years since I released Escapeworld Dilemma. In that time, many have enjoyed the game with positive reviews, and many have discovered that a game developed by a single person will not be AAA quality, but will be a little rough around the edges. Even though I invested about 4,000 or so hours in developing and supporting the game, that is certainly the case. 

So to the many who have purchased the game, thank you for your support. Having done no marketing for the game, it was by no means a financial success. To those that bought the game and have found rough edges, my apologies.

In the end, I'd like anybody that wants to play the game to be able to, so I made the decision to make the game free to play.

I will continue to monitor the community board and try to fix any issues that might come up, and provide hints if needed. 

I hope any new players enjoy the game!

Thanks,

Joe

notes.title: Graphics Options Panel Now Available. Hardware Requirements Lowered.
notes.content:
With this update, the much-requested Options Panel is now available as an in-game feature (hit the keyboard letter “O” at any time to open the panel). By lowering graphics settings in the Option Panel, lower specification hardware can now run the game.

As a result, the minimum memory requirements were lowered to 8GB RAM, and the GPU requirement was reduced to a 1050Ti/4GB VRAM (or equivalent). With all graphics settings set to Low, the game is playable with a GTX 960M, or a GT 1030, but with those GPUs, performance can drop below 30 FPS, and sometimes below 20 FPS. (See the pinned discussions topic for additional info).

The options panel allows adjustments for:
[list]
[*] Frame Rate Limit and Resolution Scaling
[*] Audio settings for footsteps, ambient, menu room music and drone buzz
[*] Mouse sensitivity and Y-Axis inversion
[*] Graphics settings for View Distance, Anti-Aliasing, Post Processing, Shadows, Textures, Foliage (which includes grass), Effects, and Field of View
[/list]
By dialing down graphics settings in the options panel, the game should now run with a consistent framerate in the 30-60 FPS range (more often in the 60 FPS range) on a system with 8GBs of memory, and a GTX 1050Ti, 4GB VRAM. 

Also included in this update - the teleport clouds were adjusted to be less graphically challenging (though they are still intense for now).

In addition, the streaming level logic was adjusted to hopefully eliminate an intermittent problem a couple of players had falling through the world (a layer did not load properly so there was nothing for them to stand on – hopefully fixed now).

A future update will include ability to run in windows (versus full screen) with lower resolution.

As usual, if you find a bug or have any feedback whatsoever on the options panel or the game itself, please send an email to support@sonoma.games.

Thanks,

Joe

notes.title: Escapeworld Dilemma Released
notes.content:
After 90 days of play with player feedback on features, bug reports, and fixes of those bugs, Escapeworld Dllemma is now complete, has exited early access, and has been formally released.


“Escapeworld Dilemma is a solid puzzle, open-world exploration game … it is a beautifully crafted and diverse environment … all in all, it was a very pleasant game experience.”   - CindyK_JA

“This is a really good adventure puzzle game. The environment is very large spanning multiple islands with different geographies and themes, from high desert to the depths of a coal mine.”   - mitchell_the_first 

"Escapeworld Dilemma is a very good puzzle and exploration game … I’ve played Portal, Talos Principle and Obduction and enjoyed playing Escapeworld Dilemma.”   - theBrionicle

"Great game, comparable with the Myst-Riven-Exile series and with the advantage that puzzles are normally solvable with nearby hints."   - lipska

notes.title: Game Update Uploaded to Steam, Considering Exit From Early Access
notes.content:
A potentially final game update prior to exit from early access was just uploaded to Steam.  It includes several minor bug fixes and a few other notable items:

[list]
[*] Mouse sensitivity can now be adjusted at any time just by using the up arrow or down arrow keys.
[*] A completely new environment was created for a mine.
[*] Ambient outside sound versus inside sound was fine-tuned
[*] Added an Easter Egg
[/list]

Bug reports have slowed to a trickle.  I will let this update bake a bit but if bug reports continue to be a trickle, the game will hopefully exit early access later this week.  

If you find a bug, please send a description to support@sonoma.games.  Thanks.
